# Klinik for børn- og unge

Klinik for børn- og unge is a private hospital clinic ("privathospital") listed in the Danish ADHD quality database's report covering the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src1]. The clinic appears in a performance table for Indicator 3, which measures how often diagnostic conferences involving specialist physicians are held as part of the ADHD assessment process for children and young people [^src1]. Nationally, this indicator reached only 27% fulfillment against a target of 90%, and Klinik for børn- og unge recorded 0% fulfillment (0 out of 8 completed courses of treatment, or "forløb"), placing it at the bottom of the reported range of 0–37% [^src1].

The clinic is also listed by name among the units covered in the report's later pages, which include appendices detailing the ADHD database population and regional/institutional breakdowns for the same reporting period [^src2]. Beyond its inclusion in this table and list, no further detail about the clinic's ownership, location, or broader operations is provided in the corpus.

This entry sits within a larger national story: the ADHD database report documents substantial underperformance against quality development goals across indicators 2b and 3, alongside regional variation — for example, positive trends in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] contrasted with a declining trend in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] — and a steering group revision of both indicators to better reflect clinical practice [^src1][^src2]. Klinik for børn- og unge's 0% score on Indicator 3 makes it one of the clinics illustrating the extent of this underperformance at the individual-provider level.
